title: Reliability of Language-Model Judges for Quantitative Scientific Question Answering: Evidence from Perovskite Photovoltaics
abstract: arXiv:2611.31269v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating retrieval-augmented language models increasingly relies on automated model judges, yet their reliability on quantitative scientific synthesis remains largely unmeasured. Here, we evaluate automated grading on a quantitative benchmark for perovskite photovoltaics, where all 755 ground-truth answers are deterministically computed from 45,441 experimental device records. We evaluate a frontier judge (Claude Opus 5.5) alongside two local open-weight judges (Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-8B) across 4,530 free-text answers from six retrieval architectures under three regimes: reference-augmented (with the computed key), evidence-augmented (with retrieved passages and query logs), and unassisted (question and answer alone). Equipped with the reference key, Claude Opus reproduces ground truth near-perfectly (Cohen's $\kappa = 0.982 \pm 0.003$) and preserves exact architectural rankings ($\tau = 1.00$). translated_title: 语言模型评判器在定量科学问答中的可靠性：来自钙钛矿光伏的证据
translated_abstract: 评估检索增强语言模型日益依赖自动化模型评判器，但其在定量科学综合任务上的可靠性在很大程度上尚未被测量。本文在一个钙钛矿光伏定量基准上评估自动化评分，其中全部755个真实答案均由45,441条实验器件记录确定性计算得出。我们评估了一个前沿评判器（Claude Opus 5.5）以及两个本地开源权重评判器（Qwen3-14B和Qwen3-8B），针对来自六种检索架构的4,530个自由文本答案，在三种模式下进行测试：参考增强（提供计算所得的参考答案）、证据增强（提供检索段落和查询日志）以及无辅助（仅提供问题和答案）。在配备参考答案的情况下，Claude Opus近乎完美地复现真实评分（Cohen's κ = 0.982 ± 0.003），并完整保留了架构排名（τ = 1.00）。取消参考答案会导致评估……
tldr: 本文构建了由45,441条钙钛矿光伏实验记录确定性生成真实答案的定量基准，系统评估语言模型评判器的可靠性，发现配备参考答案的前沿评判器Claude Opus可近乎完美地复现真实评分并精确保留架构排名。
en_tdlr: This work introduces a quantitative perovskite photovoltaics benchmark whose 755 ground-truth answers are deterministically computed from 45,441 experimental device records, and shows that a reference-augmented frontier LLM judge (Claude Opus) reproduces ground-truth grading near-perfectly (κ = 0.982) while preserving exact architectural rankings (τ = 1.00).
